title: Multi-fidelity learning predicts micellar stress-growth behavior from sparse data
summary: A multi-fidelity machine-learning model predicts formulation-specific startup stress-growth and strain-hardening behavior in wormlike micellar solutions from sparse measurements. The predictions are checked against withheld rheology data. The result concerns the tested formulations and does not establish a molecular mechanism.
ai_technology: Multi-fidelity machine-learning model for rheological stress-growth prediction
organization: Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering, Northeastern University

evidence.tested: The model predicts formulation-specific stress-growth behavior and is compared with withheld rheology measurements.
evidence.unknown: The prediction result is limited to the evaluated formulations and rheology data; no molecular mechanism is established.
evidence.ai_role: The learned multi-fidelity model combines sparse measurements to predict startup stress growth and strain hardening.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
